title: HTTP BLOB gzip uses an input-sized buffer and can serve an incomplete gzip stream
summary: The HTTP caller allocates only the uncompressed byte count for gzip output. The compressor accepts a non-final deflate result and reports partial output. For bytes 0..31 in a 32-byte buffer it returns 32 bytes; a zlib decoder returns -5 rather than Z_STREAM_END and recovers only 15/32 bytes. The HTTP caller would label and send the partial stream with 200 OK. Next: coordinator assigns bounded gzip-capacity/error-contract repair and HTTP incompressible-payload regression coverage; audit did not perform a network download.
